patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Microsoft Project share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Jira only if your buying job matches “Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo ” rather than Microsoft Project's shape. Choose Microsoft Project only if your buying job matches “Microsoft 365 project / Planner ladder for Gantt, resources and portfolios — Planner Plan ” rather than Jira's shape. Workflow advantage: Jira leans shared coverage; Microsoft Project leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Microsoft Project share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Jira is Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo annual.; Microsoft Project is Microsoft 365 project / Planner ladder for Gantt, resources and portfolios — Planner Plan 1 from ~$10/user/mo..
- Company-size focus: Jira (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Microsoft Project (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Jira-leaning — vs Microsoft Project-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Jira — Steep learning curve outside engineering; Microsoft Project — SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans.

Limitations — Jira: Steep learning curve outside engineering; Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth; Microsoft Project: SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans; Best value assumes Microsoft 365 standardisation.

Poor-fit cases: Jira is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Steep learning curve outside engineering · Microsoft Project is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans · Avoid Jira if you actually need Microsoft Project's motion (Microsoft 365 project / Planner ladder for Gantt, resources and portfolios — Pla)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
